Tableau Developer Salary in India: What to Expect Tableau is one of the most advanced and fastest-growing data visualization tools in the fast-growing business intelligence domain. This business intelligence tool facilitates the translation of raw data into a readily comprehensible format, becoming increasingly important as larger companies become more data-driven. Tableau assists specialists from both large and small businesses in analyzing massive amounts of data, resulting in a rising need for Tableau developers in India and elsewhere. Tableau is an interactive, user-friendly BI tool that may assist with data analysis and advanced analytics in the business world. This is the primary reason for the increase in Tableau developer vacancies in India. Even small and major businesses are willing to pay higher wages to hire competent Tableau Software Engineers. We will look at the Tableau Developer Salary in India and why Tableau Certification is so important if you want to work for one of the top Data Analytics and Business Intelligence companies. Factors Influencing the Salary of a Tableau Developer Tableau Developer jobs are in high demand in the Business Intelligence industry, and the Average Salary of Tableau Developers in India is around Rs.7,68 K annually and a decent annual salary of Rs 20 lakhs per year for experienced, which is among the top sectors. (All of these statistics were obtained from PayScale and Indeed.) A Tableau developer with 7+ years of expertise earns 1,500K per year in Delhi. Tableau Developers in other metro cities, like Bangalore and Chennai, may earn around Rs. 8,00K a year. If you want to work as a tableau developer in India, hunt for a job in Delhi (All of these statistics were obtained from Indeed and Naukri.) Tableau Developer Salary Based on Qualification A bachelor’s degree is required, then other bachelor’s degrees, with a master’s degree being preferred. Individuals with specialized professional skills, on the other hand, are in high demand regardless of educational background. A Tableau Developer should be familiar with the following tools: ETL Frameworks and OLAP Data Analysis Tools. SQL server skills, SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS), SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) are also necessary. Excel – Understanding the essential functionalities of Microsoft Excel is essential. A Tableau Developer must have a strong analytical mind, comfort with data, and the ability to find the best way to define data using historical and previous data for easier business decisions and to find a solution to problems that will aid in the improvement of business processes in addition to the essential qualification and experience. Tableau Developer Salary Based on Skill Set To enhance their career as a Tableau Developer, one should know Predictive Analytics principles, Statistical methods, R programming, Python, Cloud Repositories, Data extraction and loading, DBMS concepts. Individuals should understand Analytics and Business intelligence (BI) incredibly well to advance in their careers. Tableau Developers or Engineers provide data solutions and services while also doing a range of other responsibilities inside the company, such as developing BI dashboards and reports, interacting with corporate designers, and extracting information for the development of the system. As a Tableau Engineer, individuals must understand the data source and format, extract information, and convert it into a user-friendly representation; they may also serve as Tableau Server Administrators (All of these statistics were obtained from Naukri.)
